# Vendored from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-errors.md.txt
# ("This page provides a reference for all Interactions API error codes"),
# fetched during Task 6's spec-verification gate (lowercase snake_case, NOT
# the classic UPPER_SNAKE google.rpc.Code vocabulary). See
# docs/decisions/2026-08-27-google-genai-spec-verification.md Divergence 4.
#
# Fix-round-1 F10: the original version of this file vendored only the
# "Standard API error codes" table (18 codes) and the tripwire's assertion
# message implied that was the complete set -- so a legitimate future
# `[errors.safety]`-style entry (a real, documented code from either of the
# page's other two tables) would have been wrongly rejected as "not a real
# spec value." All three of the page's documented tables are vendored below
# now (35 codes total), matching what the tripwire actually asserts.

# "Standard API error codes" (general request-level, map to HTTP statuses):
invalid_request
failed_precondition
out_of_range
parameter_unknown
authentication
permission_denied
not_found
model_not_found
already_exists
aborted
rate_limit_exceeded
quota_exceeded
too_many_requests
cancelled
api_error
unimplemented
service_unavailable
deadline_exceeded

# "Generation blocked codes" (policy/safety/content restrictions):
safety
recitation
language
prohibited_content
spii
blocklist
image_safety
image_prohibited_content
image_recitation
image_other
content_blocked

# "Generation error codes" (structural issues with generated output):
malformed_function_call
malformed_tool_call
unexpected_tool_call
no_image
too_many_tool_calls
missing_thought_signature
